title: How Old Would You Be on Another Planet? Orbital Periods Explained | Space Atlas
description: A "year" is just one orbit around the Sun — and it takes wildly different amounts of time depending on the planet. Enter your age and see it recalculated for all eight.
ogTitle: How Old Would You Be on Another Planet?
ogDescription: A year is just one orbit — enter your age and see how old you'd be on Mercury, Mars, or Neptune.
jsonldName: Orbital Periods: How Old Would You Be on Another Planet?
jsonldDescription: An interactive calculator converting a user's Earth age into their equivalent age on every planet, based on each planet's orbital period.
